notes: This contract records the Java-visible subset of the official logical-time DataElement APIs. The scenario exercises HLAlogicalTime and HLAlogicalTimeInterval creation from EncoderFactory, selected-factory values, encoded length and boundary, byte-array and ByteWrapper encode/decode, cursor preservation, and truncated-input rejection. No direct normative Java mapping is claimed: the related page-378 candidate is specifically the Annex C RTI C++ header implementation requirement.

api_surfaces.signature: createHLAlogicalTime(RTIambassador), HLAlogicalTime.getValue, HLAlogicalTime.setValue, DataElement encode/decode and metadata
createHLAlogicalTimeInterval(RTIambassador), HLAlogicalTimeInterval.getValue, HLAlogicalTimeInterval.setValue, DataElement encode/decode and metadata
